purpose: Load the GlacierEQ skills that materially improve estate-wide source recovery, codebase understanding, topology and classification work, GitHub execution, connector use, evidence discipline, verification, continuation, and source-bound human presentation without globally loading unrelated domain specializations.

activation_contract.activation_semantics: A repository profile is a selection plan, not proof of activation. In each new ChatGPT session, a consumer must actually load the selected skill contract and reconcile pinned SHA to live main before claiming CONTRACT_LOADED. If a pin is stale or a tool unavailable, use the current source and other qualified routes; do not turn a source mismatch into global mission STOP. No automatic host invocation is claimed.
activation_contract.always_on_policy: Read and apply all always_on entries for substantive GlacierEQ estate work, subject to higher-priority platform constraints and current Operator scope.
activation_contract.conditional_policy: Load a conditional entry only when its trigger matches the current mission. Do not globally inject domain-specific or stale instructions.
activation_contract.external_binding_policy: For source-bound capabilities such as PSYSOC-X, preserve the owning repository as authority and load through the binding instead of copying the capability into Mega-Skills.

always_on.role: Operator authority, semantic locks, rehydration, holographic-mesh fidelity, execution/readback gate
Source-realized hydration, nearest-valid continuation, provenance-bound memory
Traceability for sources, claims, tests, contradictions, and uncertainty
Compact continuation context without replacing source state
Evidence-backed acceptance before advancement or completion claims
Skill discovery, selection, validation, composition, and lifecycle discipline
Repository intelligence, GitHub Actions, multi-repo operations, and GitHub execution
Connector/tool orchestration patterns; provider-specific configuration is advisory and must be reconciled to the live ChatGPT tool surface

conditional.trigger: Human-facing communication, README or portfolio rendering, audience calibration, progressive disclosure, title/density selection, skepticism handling, emotional-weight calibration, or any task where the same evidence-bound facts need different human and machine projections.
conditional.role: Psychosocial reasoning and human calibration: attention, tone, density, logic order, skepticism response, humor fit, memory anchors, dignity controls, and progressive disclosure without fact or evidence mutation.

conditional.trigger: Multi-step implementation, repair, or refactor that merits repository orientation, verification, and independent review
Dependent phases, durable artifacts, uncertainty, or safe resumption across work chunks
An advanced route depends on tools, access, environment, or evidence whose readiness is not yet verified
Cross-session, cross-repository, cross-provider, or changing-evidence missions requiring recoverable decisions and learning
Branch/ref convergence where living main must be preserved and unique value selectively integrated

explicitly_not_global.reason: Its documented activation sequence depends on a host activate_skill tool not exposed in this ChatGPT runtime and contains case-bound defaults that must not become estate-wide mission defaults.
Useful as a donor/conditional connector pattern, but its current contract contains case-bound mission language and provider/tool names that must be reconciled to the live runtime before use.
